kicker: FastH3 Preview v1, distilled and sparse

scenes.headline: How FastH3 makes a video model up to 14x faster
scenes.sub: Two levers on MiniMax H3: fewer transformer calls, and cheaper attention in each.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Boba! FastH3 is a distilled MiniMax H3, a model that makes video with its own audio. Here are the two levers that speed it up.

scenes.text: Call the transformer 4 times instead of 49, by distilling it, and make each call cheaper, by letting only about one attention tile in ten through.

steps.say: Training starts from prompts alone. No video, real or synthetic, is ever loaded. That's what Data-Free means.
The student, running sparse attention, generates its own sample from pure noise, in four fixed steps.
A frozen dense teacher and a trainable critic, both from the same H3 weights, score it at a randomly sampled noise level.

steps.note: the critic takes 5 steps for every student step
steps.say: Their scores pull the student's outputs toward the teacher's distribution. The critic trains five times as often, to keep up.

scenes.title: Video Sparse Attention, inside each call

steps.label: Full attention over video tiles
steps.say: Base H3 attends densely. Inside each call, VSA cuts the video into 3D tiles of sixty-four tokens.

steps.label: About 1 tile in 10 survives
steps.note: text and audio tokens stay dense
steps.say: A cheap pooled pass scores every tile. At ninety percent sparsity, only about one tile in ten gets exact attention.

steps.label: The rest pass through a trained gate
steps.say: The losing tiles aren't dropped. A trained gate, about one point nine three billion new parameters, blends a pooled summary back in.

scenes.title: Speedup over Base H3, 15-second clip, one B200
scenes.note: shorter clips gain less: 8.16x at 5 seconds
scenes.say: On a fifteen-second clip, distillation alone gives seven point four three times. Sparsity multiplies that by one point nine three, for fourteen point three eight.

scenes.text: Fewer calls and cheaper calls are separate levers. They multiply, and the longer the clip, the more sparsity pays.

recap: Data-Free: trained from prompts, never video
Sparse attention lets about 1 tile in 10 through
scenes.say: To recap: four calls instead of forty-nine, trained from prompts alone, one tile in ten attended exactly.
